environment.description: ECS Fargate task in the same VPC configuration. The task execution role and task role both have an attached IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/BoundaryForDataPlaneWorkloads). This boundary's effective policy document allows s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::default-results/* only, sqs:ReceiveMessage and sqs:DeleteMessage on the specific queue ARN, and explicitly denies s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject, iam:*, sts:AssumeRole, ec2:*, lambda:* with a Deny statement using StringNotEquals condition on aws:PrincipalTag/team-classification = 'privileged'. The SCP on the OU (ou-abc1-dataplane) includes a statement denying s3:PutObject and s3:DeleteObject unless the principal ARN matches a specific CI/CD role pattern. Additionally, the S3 VPC endpoint policy restricts PutObject and DeleteObject to source VPC endpoint vpce-0a1b2c3d from the CI/CD subnet only.

config.network: Private subnet with NAT, no DNS filtering
config.iam_policy: s3:PutObject,s3:DeleteObject,s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::*, sqs:* on queue ARN
config.permission_boundary_effect: Deny s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject unless aws:PrincipalTag/team-classification=privileged; Allow s3:GetObject on default-results/* only; Allow sqs:ReceiveMessage,sqs:DeleteMessage on queue
config.scp_effect: Deny s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject unless principal ARN matches arn:aws:iam::*:role/cicd-*
config.s3_vpc_endpoint_policy: Deny s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject unless aws:sourceVpce = vpce-0a1b2c3d (CI/CD subnet endpoint)
config.metadata_service: IMDSv2 required (hop limit 1, blocked on Fargate by default)
